name: Ecchi na Maid-san wa Suki Desu ka?
original_name: エッチなメイドさんは好きですか？
source: The main protagonist lives alone as he goes to university. As his graduation is close by, he decides to get a job. It has been a few years since he saw his parent's house, so he goes for a visit. When he gets there, he is amazed by the huge mansion that has been erected. He enters the mansion, and finds beautiful maids forming a line...
